course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A company adopted new system. The system has an installed cost of \$150,000 and. an additional cost of \$50,000 after 10 years. The annual software maintenance contract cost is \$5,000 for the first 5 years and \$10,000 thereafter. In addition, there is expected to be a recurring major upgrade cost of \$15,000 in every 13. years. Again another recurring cost is expected for every 8 years. The new system will be used for the indefinite future, find the capitalized cost for the new system.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
